title: gymnosporia alaternifolia
intro: Gymnosporia alaternifolia, commonly known as Wild Olive or African Holly, is a medicinal plant species in the family Celastraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Gymnosporia alaternifolia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
